name: Hideayo Miyazaki
source:
With an open hand, Hideayo Miyazaki is willing to befriend anyone, no matter the person— treating friendships like delicate porcelain to be gently taken care of. She's the kind of girl who's smile holds no bounds, with a semi-regular grin and frequent humor, splicing jokes between enthusiastic pep talks and endless encouragement.

Though she's incredibly well-meaning, Hideayo's boisterous nature doesn't always rub off very well. Her volume can be a lot to most who pass her— working both to her hinderance, and also to her favor. With exaggeration comes a silver of honesty; a sense of genuine compassion clinging to her words. If anyone's got your back, it's definitely Hideayo.
